author: CNET
description: Instead of going all-in on a rugged sports-watch look, the Moto Watch is designed to feel like a jack of all trades, with advanced features like dual-band GPS and a battery life that lasts over a week. The $150 Moto Watch combines a polished design with Polar-backed health tracking. Let’s unbox it. ⌚️ #motorola #motowatch #tech #smartwatch #wearables
title: Unboxing Motorola’s New $150 Moto Watch
